सुघटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Well-contrived or devised, well-arranged or
managed.
 2. Well-joined or united.
 3. Brought into agreeable
contract.
 E. सु, and घटित contrived.

सुघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hideous, terrific.
 E. सु very, घोर fearful.

सुघोष m. (-षः) A pleasant sound.
 E. सु, and घोष sound or cry.
